# Migration of the onboarding workflow

We completed the migration on 13 August 2026. The team reviewed scope, budget, and timeline before the change window opened. Adoption rose 12 percent across the three regions we monitor.

## What we found

Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) grew for the second period. We expect ARR to hold through the next cycle. The register records the same figure (Harlow, 2024). The cost of the change came to USD 1,200 in total.

## What we recommend

- Confirms the migration window
- Records the final figure
- Notes the open risk

We recommend that you review the draft before the close of the window. The delivery team will circulate a short note once the final figure lands.
